title: Stop Saying "Very Fast"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very fast". Use one of these words instead:
• Rapid: rapid growth
• Swift: a swift reply
• Speedy: a speedy recovery
• Lightning-fast: lightning-fast internet
• Breakneck: at breakneck speed
